author: Ash

copy.intro: Your Dairy Boy camo crewneck sold out in your size again, or you want something with more weight to it. Dairy Boy's own sweatshirts run from $88 to $95, so that's the line everything here gets measured against. The list is short for now. It only holds a real swap for the sweatshirt itself, with the price, sizes and returns laid out so you can compare before you buy.

bodies.madhappy:
Madhappy is where to go if you want a heavier cotton sweatshirt than Dairy Boy makes and you don't mind paying for it. Start with the Classics Fleece Crewneck ($165), a heavyweight 100% cotton fleece made in Los Angeles.

That's nearly double Dairy Boy's Oversized Crewneck ($88), and it's a different kind of sweatshirt. Dairy Boy's camo crews are cotton French terry, and its Cloud Terry pieces are made to skip the weight of a traditional sweatshirt. Sizes run XXS to XXL in a relaxed unisex fit, so the range matches. Returns are kinder here: 30 days instead of 18, and the $12 refund fee goes away if you take store credit or an exchange.

Two catches. One crewneck falls just short of free US shipping, which starts at $200. And the Dodgers, Disney and Peanuts hoodies are final sale, so buy those only when you're sure of the size.

best_for.madhappy: a heavyweight cotton crewneck made in Los Angeles

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body: If price is the point, stay with Dairy Boy. Its crews and hoodies stop at $95, and orders over $175 ship free in the US. It's also the place for camo, with Lowcountry and Decoy Camo in its current crews and hoodies. If you want a heavier fleece and more time to send it back, Madhappy's Classics line is the swap, at $165 for the crewneck and $185 for the zip-up. Size won't decide it for you, since both go from XXS to XXL. And if you're near Nantucket or one of Madhappy's US shops, you can see the fabric in person before you choose.

faqs.a: Paige Lorenze started Dairy Boy in 2021. It's a clothing, denim and housewares brand, and it traces its roots to her New England childhood.
Yes. You get 18 days after delivery to return clothing for a refund, minus a $10.95 shipping fee, or 30 days for store credit. Accessories, home goods and intimates are final sale.
